title: Stem Fix
description: The melon stem isn't normally attached to the melon when it grows, but this resource pack fixes that!
body:
# Melon/Pumpkin Stem Fix!

Have you ever had a night where you just could not sleep because you kept thinking about the melon stem not being attached to the plant? Well, this resource pack can fix that! It adds:
- The melon stem being attached!
- The pumpkin stem being attached!
- saying it's for a different version when it's actually not!
- AND SO MUCH MORE! (not)

![this is what it's gonna look like](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b55ae3fc745b90b8c16eb54e63a31714953c19e.png)



This project was not at all created for serious reasons, and I don't think this is how melons grow either, but it's an improvement from what we had, and you might giggle at it. Maybe it was worth spending half an hour trying to hook up the textures after all!

I also have a different version, but I don't think I can upload it because it's just so horrible to look at. So disclaimer, the pic under is NOT the real resource pack, check the gallery for that!
### NOT THE REAL RP!!! VVVV
![NOT THE REAL RP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/827bdb20f35df580a705926e2beb7665691c7ae9.png)
If this gets popular I'll upload this one too.
